bias.en: Rebound · back above the 200-day, under the 5-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · 重回 200 日均线上方，仍在 5 日均线下方

read.en: AMD rose 11.0% on Nov 6 to $449.04, trading $433.30–459.78 on heavy volume. It reclaimed the rising 200-day average ($416.0) but is still below the falling 5-day ($458.6), 10-day ($503.4), 30-day ($559.3) and 100-day ($526.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9, below zero, with the histogram narrowing slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($554.85), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: AMD 11月6日上涨 11.0%，收于 $449.04，盘中区间 $433.30–459.78，成交量明显放大。股价重新站上上行的 200 日均线（$416.0），但仍位于下行的 5 日（$458.6）、10 日（$503.4）、30 日（$559.3）和 100 日均线（$526.9）下方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图略有收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$554.85），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The rally reclaimed $415 (200-day), $424 (Jul 29 low) and $440.5 (Sep 3 low), now support, and stalled near the 5-day. Resistance is $451–459.8 (Aug 24 low, 5-day, Nov 6 high), then $466.1–476.5 (Nov 2–4 lows) and $502.6–503.4 (Oct 22 low, 10-day). Support is $433.3–440.5, then $416–424 and $400–402. A close above $459.8 would target $466–476; below $433, $416–424.
